Cut 7 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6417034209`. Three bodies of the "execute and transactions" section move unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-execute-transactions.ts`: `execute`, `warnTransactionUnsupported` and `enforceTransactionOrigin`. No behaviour changes. #25522 stays open for the later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-tsjhtm` (the card thread's harness-pinned branch), cut from `origin/main` at `a6e8f95d6` (after cut 6, `3380671aef`), with `main` merged once at `d1ea2363f` because #26026 (which edits `engine.ts`) landed during the cut and this PR lands second. #26026's hunks sit in Autonumber, `insert` and `update`; none is in this PR's range.

A body stays if any of these holds: an inferred-return public method, a U site, a private-static read, an `engine.ts#NAME` pointer under `packages/spec/**` or `docs/adr/**`, a `this.update(` / `this.insert(` / `this.delete(` self-call, or a static. Bodies earlier cuts moved are counted as stubs, not as movable.

Pricing (net `engine.ts` lines): a stub costs a comment, the host literal's open and close and the `.call`, plus two lines per field read (a `read*` closure and a getter) and one per method read (a late-bound closure); the import adds three.

What stays in the section: `transaction` (ADR-0119 cites it as `engine.ts#transaction`, and ADR-0067's join lives in it), and `runOpenedUnit` (4 body lines), `isClosedUnitHandle` (3), `newTransactionScope` (5) and `datasourceNameOf` (4), whose stubs would cost as much as their bodies.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1 to 6 apply it)

- The class keeps all three methods with name, modifiers, signature, docblock and position. Each body is now one host literal plus `fn.call(host, …)`, marked `[#25522 cut 7]`. `execute` stays public with its declared return type (a `Promise` of `any`), so it is not an inferred-return public member.
- `ExecuteTransactionsHost` is new: `drivers`, `defaultDriver`, `txStore`, `transactionUnsupportedReported`, `logger`, `getDriver`, `datasourceNameOf`, `isSystemLedgerObject`, each typed as the class member (`ObjectQL['txStore']`). Each moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of exactly the members its body reads, and each stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType` of that function. There is no cast, and no member changes visibility.
- The five fields go as GETTERS (`registerDriver` replaces the driver map's contents and the default), so each read happens when the body makes it. The three methods go as late-bound closures over the instance, so a double or spy set on the engine still intercepts.
- `warnTransactionUnsupported` keeps its default parameter (`declaredUnsupported = false`) on both the method and the function; the stub passes the value it received.
- **Imports.** The module imports `ObjectQL` as a TYPE only and nothing re-exports it. `engine.ts` drops `CrossDatasourceTransactionWriteError` from its `transaction-errors.js` import, because its last code reader moved; three docblocks that stay still name it in a `{@link}` (on `planCascadeAtomicity`, `transaction` and `enforceTransactionOrigin`); their text is unchanged, so the published `.d.ts`, which prints the public `transaction` docblock, is byte-identical (measured below). `redactPropagatedDriverFault` and `TransactionUnsupportedError` still have readers in `engine.ts` and stay. The module-scope `ScopedContext` helper's call `engine.warnTransactionUnsupported?.(…)` still reaches the method on the class.

## Net lines (the seat's rule)

`engine.ts` goes from 23,241 to 23,165 lines, **net -76** (31 added, 107 removed). The module is 199 lines: the header and host interface (about 66), three one-line docblocks, and the 106 moved body lines with their signatures. The diff is 346 changed lines over 3 files (+239 / -107), far under the 3,000-line human-merge threshold.

## Proof of move-only

A TypeScript-AST leaf-token compare (recursive `getChildren`, JSDoc skipped) of base `engine.ts` (`d1ea2363f`) against the head module:

- For each of the three, the parameters (less `this`, default value included), return type, type parameters and body tokens are **SAME**, `async` matches, and every body line equals the base line less two leading spaces, comments included: `execute` 263 tokens / 55 lines, `warnTransactionUnsupported` 89 / 26, `enforceTransactionOrigin` 142 / 25.
- **Negative controls:** flipping `===` to `!==` in the moved `execute` (`params === undefined`) reports DIFFER; editing only one comment in the moved `enforceTransactionOrigin` fails the line rule. Both exit 1, and the module was restored from `HEAD` and blob hash compared after each.
- Class: 318 members at both ends, in the same order. 315 are byte-identical (full text, docblocks included), and the 3 stubs keep docblock, modifiers and signature byte-identical up to the body.
- Top level: 228 of 230 base statements are byte-identical in head. The other two are the class and the narrowed `transaction-errors.js` import. Head adds the new module import with its comment.

## Readers of the moved lines

- **ADR anchor (migrated in this PR).** `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__engine.ts.json` carries one paragraph, the transaction seam, and it describes `enforceTransactionOrigin` (plus `buildDriverOptions` and `TransactionScope`, which stay). Per the card, the new module gets its own entry carrying that paragraph verbatim: `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__engine-execute-transactions.ts.json`, ADR-0057, ADR-0067 and ADR-0119, each named in the module (the moved `enforceTransactionOrigin` body cites ADR-0057 §3.6, and the module header names all three). This is a data row the existing `check-adr-anchors` reads (one JSON file per anchored path, no index to register), not a new gate; the engine entry stays as it is, because all three ids and the stubs it describes remain in `engine.ts`. `check-adr-anchors` at base `d1ea2363f`: 88 anchored files, 1,879 decision-letter citations; at head: 89 anchored files, 1,879 decision-letter citations (also 88 / 1,879 at `a6e8f95d6`). The moved bodies cite no decision letter, and the module header uses none.
- No `engine.ts#NAME` pointer anywhere names the three. `docs/adr/0096` names `engine.ts` beside `engine.execute()` (file-level); the method is still on the class, so it still resolves.
- No gate or source-reading test matches the moved text: every `scripts/` reader of `engine.ts` was screened, and the 32 test files that read `engine.ts` from disk. The two `packages/core` door pins and the `packages/types` caller pin (which walk every `.ts` file) were run and are green.
- `packages/spec/liveness`: 46 evidence strings cite `engine.ts`, and none quotes text from the moved bodies (screened for their identifiers and refusal strings).
- **Census and receivers.** `check-tenant-audit-census` is green (243 write call sites; the moved bodies hold no `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site). `check:logger-receiver-detach` is green (two moved bodies read `logger` through a getter, so the receiver is kept), and so are `check-system-context-census` and `check:durability-log-level`.

## Acceptance notes

- Prose that names `engine.ts` beside a moved method still resolves by method name, because every method stays on the class (for example `transaction-errors.ts` naming `enforceTransactionOrigin`). Left as it is.
- The engine anchor paragraph now sits on two files, each describing the half it holds; the paragraph is carried verbatim, as the card asks, rather than split.
- Serial check, re-read before `pr_create`: 36 PRs are open; the only one on `packages/objectql/**` is #26132 (`hook-run-as.test.ts` only). #26026 landed during the cut and is merged in. `origin/main` moved five commits after the merge, none on `packages/objectql/**` or `scripts/adr-anchors/**`, and `dispatch-gates` printed no stale-tree warning, so it was not merged again.
- Next cut from this screen: Compatibility API (about -69, with `syncSchemas` hot); nothing else pays without a ruling (Migration flags needs setters).

The run includes `engine-transaction-contract.test.ts`, `engine-transaction-declared-unsupported.test.ts`, `engine-transaction-observability.test.ts`, `engine-transaction-same-origin.test.ts` and `engine-scoped-transaction-late-write.test.ts`.

- Gates at `afe19760a`: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 66 families on the real diff. Every one was run, each exit code captured before any pipe, then reconciled with `--ran`: 66 accounted for, 65 run, 1 NOT MEASURED. **NOT MEASURED** (CI runs it): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it needs every package's `dist/`; the export lists above answer it for objectql). Named readings: `check-system-context-census` OK (151 read sites, 144 of 144 symbols cited), `check:logger-receiver-detach` OK (3,733 files, 0 detaches), `check:durability-log-level` exit 0, `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` 97.6%.
